title: WatchParty for Stremio
shortDescription: Watch Stremio together with synced playback, room chat, and private invite links.
detailedDescription:
Watch together, without counting down in a group chat.

WatchParty adds a shared room beside Stremio Web, so you can watch with friends, talk about the moment and keep playback together. The redesigned interface puts joining, inviting and chatting first, with room controls and personal settings in their own clear sections.

GET STARTED
1. Everyone installs WatchParty and opens Stremio Web.
2. Choose content you can all access, then create a room in the WatchParty sidebar.
3. Share the invite link. Your friends open it, enter a display name and join.
4. Keep Stremio Web open while watching. The room follows the host's playback.

MADE FOR WATCHING TOGETHER
- Synchronized play, pause, seeking and playback speed, with a catch-up control when needed.
- Room chat, emoji reactions and GIFs shared by direct image link.
- Ready checks with a countdown before starting together.
- Shared playback bookmarks to return to a moment.
- Public or invite-only rooms, separate directory visibility and transferable host controls.
- A Chrome side panel for room status and chat alongside your Stremio session.
- Clear connection, joining and recovery messages, plus adjustable appearance and chat preferences.

WHAT YOU NEED
WatchParty works on supported Stremio Web pages. Keep the local Stremio application/service running when your playback source requires it. Each person needs their own access to the content and a compatible playback source. WatchParty does not supply movies or shows, share subscriptions, or bypass DRM or provider restrictions. Synchronization depends on each participant's connection and player; it is not a guarantee of frame-perfect playback.

PRIVACY, IN PLAIN LANGUAGE
No separate WatchParty account is required; choose a display name. The service processes room, connection and playback information to operate the room. Public-room chat is not end-to-end encrypted. Invite-only room chat is encrypted in participants' browsers, but room metadata, membership and playback events are not end-to-end encrypted. Keep the complete private invite link private: it contains the keys needed to join and read that room's chat. Shared GIFs load from their image host.

The extension reads relevant Stremio page/player context and local-service availability to provide these features. It does not sell user data or use it for advertising. Full details: https://watchparty.mertd.me/privacy.html

WatchParty is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Stremio. All participants should use content they are authorized to access.
singlePurpose: Let people watch together on supported Stremio Web pages through shared rooms with synchronized playback and in-room communication.

permissionJustifications.declarativeNetRequestWithHostAccess: Apply packaged request/response header rules only to HTTP requests to the local Stremio service on localhost or 127.0.0.1 port 11470, initiated by supported Stremio Web domains. Chrome's initiator-domain filter includes subdomains, but explicit page host access is restricted to the three exact supported Stremio hosts. This allows local playback and service requests. The rules do not read request bodies, affect arbitrary websites or ports, block advertising, or redirect browsing.
permissionJustifications.offscreen: Create an offscreen document only when needed to copy a room invite or content link after a user chooses a copy action. The service worker has no document or clipboard surface of its own.
permissionJustifications.storage: Keep the user's display name, preferences, room/session recovery state and private-room access keys available across extension surfaces. Private chat keys use memory-backed session storage rather than persistent local storage; Stremio authentication state remains in service-worker memory.
permissionJustifications.scripting: Restore packaged WatchParty controls in already-open supported tabs after installation or an update when possible; a page refresh may still be required. No remotely hosted executable code is injected. Unpacked development builds also use this API for explicitly granted local website access, which is removed from the store manifest.
permissionJustifications.sidePanel: Provide the WatchParty room and chat companion in Chrome's side panel when the user opens the extension.
permissionJustifications.hostPermissions: The production package retains localhost:11470 and 127.0.0.1:11470 host patterns for the Stremio service, including availability and compatibility checks, plus exact HTTPS host access to web.stremio.com, web.strem.io and app.strem.io so local-service header rules and packaged-script recovery can operate on those supported pages. Packaged content scripts run on these Stremio hosts and watchparty.mertd.me to provide the sidebar and website-to-extension joining. Development backend/website permissions are excluded from the store package. The extension does not request all-sites or browser-history API access.

remoteCode.explanation: Executable extension code, styles and emoji-picker code/data are bundled in the extension. Remote room messages, title metadata and user-shared image URLs are data, not downloaded executable code.

dataDisclosures.personallyIdentifiableInformation: User-chosen display name and persistent WatchParty session identifiers used for participation and recovery. No separate WatchParty email/password account is required.
dataDisclosures.authenticationInformation: Private-room access keys, session ownership tokens and browser-memory chat encryption keys. Stremio authentication information is read from the supported Stremio page, retained only in worker memory and used with Stremio's API for the user's addon context; it is not sent to the WatchParty room backend.
dataDisclosures.personalCommunications: Room chat, reactions and GIF image links. Public-room chat is plaintext to the room service; private-room chat is client-encrypted. Room membership and playback events are not end-to-end encrypted.
dataDisclosures.location: Connection IP addresses are processed by hosting and the room service for connectivity, security and rate limiting. The extension does not request GPS or device geolocation.
dataDisclosures.webHistory: Only supported Stremio page/player routes and URLs needed to identify and share the active title or compatible playback source; not general browsing history.
dataDisclosures.userActivity: In-room playback controls, timestamps, ready checks and connection/presence events needed for synchronization and recovery; not unrelated browsing or advertising analytics.
dataDisclosures.websiteContent: Current Stremio title/player metadata, relevant page storage and addon/runtime context, plus user-shared links and bookmarks needed for the visible room features.
dataDisclosures.limitedUse: Data is used for WatchParty's stated room/synchronization features and security. It is not sold, used for advertising or transferred for creditworthiness or lending decisions. Apply the dashboard's final declarations against the submitted code and deployed service, not a blanket 'no user data' claim.

screenshots.captureRequirements: Use the actual current packaged UI in an isolated test room with fictional names and non-sensitive sample media. No production user data, private invite fragments, unsupported feature mockups or outdated popup-first flow. Full-bleed images with square corners; inspect at half size for readable text.
